Validate one candidate beat against CURRENT JOB. Return exactly one JSON object {"valid": boolean, "issue": string}.

TEMPORAL ACTION OWNERSHIP: If CURRENT JOB assigns action X to THIS beat, require the candidate to narrate X as an event that happens now. Grammar that merely presupposes X is already complete is INVALID evidence for X. Examples include "with X done", "with X slain", "after X was completed", "once X was finished", or equivalent completed-state wording. Reject even when the completed state matches the desired result and later CURRENT JOB parts are shown correctly. Accept only if the candidate also narrates the causative action itself in this beat.

PREVIOUS FINAL BEAT
The operator reaches the sealed chamber.

CURRENT STATE
The primary blast door is closed.

CURRENT JOB
The operator opens the primary blast door and enters the chamber.

CANDIDATE BEAT
With the primary blast door open, the operator walks into the chamber.
